exercises.q: I look out of the window.
exercises.why: **гляжу** — гляде́ть (imperfective): to look; to look after, to take care of.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **Гляди** — гляде́ть (imperfective): to look; to look after, to take care of.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **взгляну** — взгляну́ть (perfective): to glance at, to look at; (figurative) to take a look (at), to pay attention to. Wiktionary: вз- + -гляну́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **Взгляни** — взгляну́ть (perfective): to glance at, to look at; (figurative) to take a look (at), to pay attention to. Wiktionary: вз- + -гляну́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Look at the woman over there!
exercises.why: **Погляди** — погляде́ть (perfective): to look, to glance; to look after, to take care of. Wiktionary: по- + гляде́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **поглядел** — погляде́ть (perfective): to look, to glance; to look after, to take care of. Wiktionary: по- + гляде́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **Загляни** — загляну́ть (perfective): to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at); (colloquial) to drop in (on), to look in (on), to call (on). Wiktionary: за- + -гляну́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to glance at, to look at
to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: гляде́ть — to look; взгляну́ть — to glance at, to look at; погляде́ть — to look, to glance; загляну́ть — to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at).
**Загляните** — загляну́ть (perfective): to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at); (colloquial) to drop in (on), to look in (on), to call (on). Wiktionary: за- + -гляну́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Tom furtively glanced at his watch.
exercises.why: **поглядывал** — погля́дывать (imperfective): to cast a glance (from time to time); to look (after), to keep an eye (on). Wiktionary: погляде́ть + -ывать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: He took a sideways glance at her legs.
exercises.why: **поглядывал** — погля́дывать (imperfective): to cast a glance (from time to time); to look (after), to keep an eye (on). Wiktionary: погляде́ть + -ывать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Did you have a look inside?
exercises.why: **заглядывал** — загля́дывать (imperfective): to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at); (colloquial) to drop in (on), to look in (on), to call (on). Wiktionary: заглянуть + -ывать.
